resources.string: Your sending phones sync with this phone at these times while they\'re charging. A phone that isn\'t charging then syncs as soon as it\'s plugged in.
Phones sync as soon as they\'re charging and have new photos. This phone listens while it\'s charging.
Only when you tap Sync now
Nothing runs in the background. Keep MediaSync open on this phone while syncing.
While it\'s charging, this phone gets ready to receive 5 minutes before each time and stays ready until your phones are done.
While MediaSync is open, your phones can sync with this phone at any time.
A sending phone asked for Turbo transfer
Allow MediaSync to connect to nearby devices, so the two phones can link up directly. Then start Turbo on the sending phone again. MediaSync doesn\'t use your location.
Turn on location, so the two phones can link up directly: before Android 13, direct Wi-Fi links need it. Then start Turbo on the sending phone again.
The sending phone is joining a direct Wi-Fi link to this phone. Keep the two phones close together.
